mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(tui_hao_shu), 0) AS refundCount, ROUND(NVL(SUM(tui_hao_shu), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(total_guahao), 0) * 100, 2) || '%' AS refundRate, NVL(SUM(shuang_yue_shu), 0) AS noShowCount, ROUND(NVL(SUM(shuang_yue_shu), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(total_guahao), 0) * 100, 2) || '%' AS noShowRate FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT '重庆' AS itemName, NVL(SUM(shuang_yue_chong_qing), 0) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND shuang_yue_chong_qing > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '四川', NVL(SUM(shuang_yue_si_chuan), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND shuang_yue_si_chuan > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '贵州', NVL(SUM(shuang_yue_gui_zhou), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND shuang_yue_gui_zhou > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '云南', NVL(SUM(shuang_yue_yun_nan), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND shuang_yue_yun_nan > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '其他', NVL(SUM(shuang_yue_qi_ta), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND shuang_yue_qi_ta > 0
SELECT '重庆' AS itemName, NVL(SUM(tui_hao_chong_qing), 0) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND tui_hao_chong_qing > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '四川', NVL(SUM(tui_hao_si_chuan), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND tui_hao_si_chuan > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '贵州', NVL(SUM(tui_hao_gui_zhou), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND tui_hao_gui_zhou > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '云南', NVL(SUM(tui_hao_yun_nan), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND tui_hao_yun_nan > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '其他', NVL(SUM(tui_hao_qi_ta), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND tui_hao_qi_ta > 0
ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT '窗口' AS itemName, NVL(SUM(tui_hao_chuang_kou), 0) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND tui_hao_chuang_kou > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '自助机', NVL(SUM(tui_hao_zi_zhu_ji), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT WHERE stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND tui_hao_zi_zhu_ji > 0 ORDER BY itemValue DESC
